integrity: Proof and two independently implemented, standard-library verification programs are included. The finite programs test rather than prove the general case.
scientific_limitations: Exact graph coloring and clique number, not maximum independent sets or code capacities; induced C5 is established for 4 <= k <= n-4 only. The all-length theorem uses the published Type-A alternating-interval characterization. Priority over unindexed work and independent audit are not claimed.
title: Sharp fixed-composition coloring of the two-read deletion graph despite induced odd holes
